trust_decision.summary: Server decides whether admin-supplied branding.footerHtml is safe to hand to every (including unauthenticated) client in the public site config; at the pinned commit it passes the raw string through on write (AdminModel::updateConfig), on load (AdminModel::getConfig) and on public projection (AdminModel::buildPublicSubset), relying only on client-side sanitizers.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'footerHtml in Public Site Config'; buildPublicSubset is the public-config builder and footerHtml is the only branding key there without a sanitize* call (neighbours at 163-213 all have one).

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/public/siteConfig.php (UserController::siteConfig regenerate branch) and GET /api/admin/getConfig.php (AdminController::getConfig, public subset for non-admins)
POST /api/admin/updateConfig.php (AdminController::updateConfig -> AdminModel::updateConfig, persisted to adminConfig.json and siteConfig.json)
every caller of AdminModel::getConfig (getConfig.php, siteConfig regenerate, AuthController)
fix_sites.module_kind: domain model, config loader / normalizer (reload path)

fix_sites.entry_point: new private helpers sanitizeFooterHtml / sanitizeFooterNode / isSafeFooterHref used by the three sites

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/FileRise/Domain/AdminModel.php:1106-1109 (getConfig load-time normalization of stored branding; fix adds footerHtml at fix.diff:224-226)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Stored config can only be written by an admin through updateConfig, which is now sanitized, so re-sanitizing on load (and re-checking the already-built siteConfig.json cache) looks redundant.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Footer must keep safe text, inline formatting (a,b,strong,em,i,span,small,br) and http/https/mailto/relative/# links with target _blank/_self (rel=noopener noreferrer added); escaping or strip_tags of the whole value breaks the documented Pro footer branding.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: fix.diff:149, fix.diff:172-189, fix.diff:866-868; client renderers expect HTML at public/js/main.js:1279-1283 and public/js/shareBranding.js:250-256

O6_input_shapes: script / svg / img and other non-allow-listed elements (replaced by their text)
event-handler and arbitrary attributes (onclick, onerror, data-*) on allowed tags
javascript: and other non-http(s)/mailto schemes in href
protocol-relative // hrefs and hrefs with control characters
control characters in the raw string, and length cap of 2000
target values other than _blank/_self; rel forced for _blank
non-string values (cast) and nested allowed tags (recursive walk)

O7_producer.where: src/FileRise/Domain/AdminModel.php:377-398 writes USERS_DIR/siteConfig.json; src/FileRise/Http/Controllers/UserController.php:948-1017 serves it as-is when its mtime >= adminConfig.json

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/public/siteConfig.php (and legacy /api/siteConfig.php) serve a fresh cached siteConfig.json without re-running buildPublicSubset, so a footerHtml cached before the fix is returned unsanitized; the cached branch re-normalizes only URL branding keys.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The cache is produced by buildPublicSubset, which is now sanitized, so values in it are assumed already clean; only pre-upgrade caches are affected.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (Http/Controllers vs Domain) from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: server-side injection of branding.footerHtml (e.g. a noscript footer) read straight from siteConfig.json into index.html
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: index.php already reads the cached siteConfig.json and injects other branding values (meta description, favicons) into the HTML, each with its own local sanitizer, so a maintainer adding a server-rendered footer here is plausible and would bypass AdminModel.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a merge of branding overrides (e.g. per-source or portal footer) into $cfg before writeSiteConfig, bypassing buildPublicSubset's sanitizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Storage-source admin services already rebuild and write the public site config themselves (also src/FileRise/Domain/ProSourcesApiService.php:179-180), making them a natural place for an extra branding merge.

O9_family: XSS / stored HTML injection via unsanitized admin-configured branding HTML in a public config API (CWE-79)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x CLI with composer (composer.json: sabre/dav, phpseclib, openid-connect-php, twofactorauth, qr-code); DOM extension for the fix's sanitizer
O10_build.project_tests: Plain PHP scripts in tests/security/*.php (e.g. tests/security/auth_security_regressions.php) run with the php CLI using FR_TEST_* env dirs; no footer/siteConfig test at the pinned commit (fix adds tests/security/public_site_config_footer_regressions.php calling AdminModel::buildPublicSubset directly).

j.j_sites_touched: src/FileRise/Domain/AdminModel.php (advisory part); the same commit also changes src/FileRise/Http/Controllers/AuthController.php for unrelated auth advisories
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap footerHtml at AdminModel.php:214 in htmlspecialchars/strip_tags inside buildPublicSubset only, which both breaks legitimate links/formatting and leaves the save path, load path and cached siteConfig.json untouched.
